interest.en: OK. That sounds quite interesting, but let's find out how it works in practice.
interest.zh: 好的。听起来挺有意思的，那我们来看看它在实践中是如何运作的吧。

interest.en: I hope it's been an interesting one and that you've learnt something new.
interest.zh: 希望这期节目生动有趣，也希望你学到了新的知识。

interest.en: Well, that's interesting because Dr Henning Holle wanted to study whether just thinking about itching makes us more likely to feel itchy.
interest.zh: Well, that's interesting because Dr Henning Holle wanted to study whether just thinking about itching makes us more likely to feel itchy.

interest.en: Let's say, for the sake of example, a nuclear power plant takes 10 years to build, you will pay €1 billion in interest payments on a €1 billion loan.
interest.zh: 假设建一座核电站需要10年时间，那么在10亿欧元的贷款上，你光是利息就要支付10亿欧元。

indeed.en: And what we found in this study was, yes, these scratching videos indeed made people feel itchier.
indeed.zh: And what we found in this study was, yes, these scratching videos indeed made people feel itchier.

indeed.en: So, it is indeed a beard scratch that we were listening to.
indeed.zh: So, it is indeed a beard scratch that we were listening to.

increase.en: Also, they're fun to watch. Claudia says there's an increase in perfectionism among young people.
increase.zh: 而且，这些视频看起也挺有意思的。Claudia 表示，年轻群体中的完美主义倾向正在上升。

increase.en: What we do know is that there is an increase in perfectionism.
increase.zh: 我们确知的是，完美主义倾向（perfectionism）正在抬头。

involve.en: Factory work involved long hours of physically demanding labor.
involve.zh: 工厂工作涉及长时间的体力消耗劳动。

involve.en: It hasn't been tested. And there are some criticisms of the videos because they involve filming your interactions with strangers, which people might not want.
involve.zh: 它尚未经过科学验证。而且这些视频也受到了一些批评，因为拍摄涉及与陌生人的互动，而对方可能并不希望被拍。

involve.en: Traditionally, this is eaten on Sundays, hence the name, and it involves roasted meat, chicken, pork, lamb, beef, sometimes other things like turkey as well potatoes, vegetables, gravy, Yorkshire pudding.
involve.zh: 传统上，这在周日食用，因此得名，它包括烤肉——鸡肉、猪肉、羊肉、牛肉，有时还有火鸡等其他东西——土豆、蔬菜、肉汁、约克郡布丁。

interaction.en: It hasn't been tested. And there are some criticisms of the videos because they involve filming your interactions with strangers, which people might not want.
interaction.zh: 它尚未经过科学验证。而且这些视频也受到了一些批评，因为拍摄涉及与陌生人的互动，而对方可能并不希望被拍。

industry.en: In January of this year, January of 2026, the German Chancellor, Friedrich Merz, stood in front of the Chamber of Industry and Commerce in Dessau and admitted, in no uncertain terms , that his country, Germany, had made a mistake.
industry.zh: 今年1月，也就是2026年1月，德国总理 Friedrich Merz 站在德绍工商会面前，毫不含糊地承认他的国家——德国，犯了一个错误。

initial.en: Anyway, its initial projected cost was £18 billion, and it was expected to come online in 2025.
initial.zh: 不管怎样，其最初预计成本为180亿英镑，原计划于2025年并网发电。

initial.en: Today, that number is zero. And many countries, especially in Europe, have gone a similar route: initial excitement in the post-war period about this "new" and revolutionary technology, and then a turn towards protest and opposition.
initial.zh: 如今，这一数字为零。许多国家，尤其是欧洲国家，都走过了一条相似的道路：战后初期对这项“全新”且具有革命性的技术充满热情，随后转向抗议和反对。

invasion.en: After the Russian invasion of Ukraine, it became clear that relying on cheap Russian gas hadn't been the smartest move.
invasion.zh: 在俄罗斯入侵乌克兰之后，事实证明，依赖廉价的俄罗斯天然气并不是最明智的举动。

increasingly.en: And increasingly, governments have concluded that nuclear and renewables need to work together, with nuclear providing the steady backbone that a renewable -heavy grid needs to actually function.
increasingly.zh: 越来越多的政府得出结论：核能和可再生能源需要协同工作，由核能提供稳定的骨干支撑，以使依赖可再生能源的电网能够真正运转。

increasingly.en: Critics point out that decisions made about something as safety-critical as nuclear power are increasingly being made by companies whose main interest is keeping their data centres running, not public accountability .
increasingly.zh: 批评人士指出，像核电这样攸关安全的重大决策，正日益由那些主要利益是维持数据中心运行、而非对公众负责的公司来制定。

intelligence.en: They've been around for decades, and despite what the fear mongering might have you believe, most of what they do has nothing to do with artificial intelligence.
intelligence.zh: 它们已经存在了几十年，尽管某些耸人听闻的言论可能会让你胡思乱想，但它们的大部分工作与人工智能毫无关系。

intensive.en: Then came generative AI which, as I'm sure you know, or might remember from episode 585, has much more intensive energy requirements.
intensive.zh: 接着，生成式人工智能横空出世，相信大家也知道，或者可能还记得第585期节目里讲过的，它对能源的需求要密集得多。

invest.en: The first is that big technology companies are still investing in nuclear energy despite these frequent cost overruns , which gives you some idea of just how desperate they are for power.
invest.zh: 第一，尽管成本超支频发，大型科技公司仍在投资核能，这足以说明它们对电力有多么渴望。

invest.en: Some are restarting old plants, others are buying capacity from existing plants, others are investing in companies building small modular reactors , which are, as the name suggests, smaller reactors that are built off-site and then assembled, a bit like IKEA furniture, but with, I trust, slightly more helpful instructions.
invest.zh: 有的在重启老旧电站，有的在从现有电站购买产能，还有的在投资建造小型模块化反应堆的公司。顾名思义，这些是较小的反应堆，在场外制造然后组装，有点像宜家家具，但我相信其说明书肯定要更管用一点。

instruction.en: Some are restarting old plants, others are buying capacity from existing plants, others are investing in companies building small modular reactors , which are, as the name suggests, smaller reactors that are built off-site and then assembled, a bit like IKEA furniture, but with, I trust, slightly more helpful instructions.
instruction.zh: 有的在重启老旧电站，有的在从现有电站购买产能，还有的在投资建造小型模块化反应堆的公司。顾名思义，这些是较小的反应堆，在场外制造然后组装，有点像宜家家具，但我相信其说明书肯定要更管用一点。

investment.en: But there has been significant investment and progress in solving this issue.
investment.zh: 但在解决这一问题上，已经有了大量投资和长足进展。

investment.en: But something has changed here too. More than fourteen billion dollars in investment has gone into fusion companies, and almost a third of that arrived in the past year alone.
investment.zh: 但这里也发生了一些变化。超过140亿美元的投资涌入了核聚变公司，其中近三分之一是在过去一年里注入的。

include.en: People had to make use of almost everything available to them, including eating parts of animals that we might be less comfortable eating today.
include.zh: 人们必须利用几乎所有可用的东西，包括吃今天我们可能不太乐意吃的动物部位。

inferior.en: There was nothing unusual or inferior about the British diet.
inferior.zh: 英国人的饮食没有什么不寻常或低人一等的。

influential.en: France was becoming one of the most influential countries in Europe.
influential.zh: 法国正在成为欧洲最有影响力的国家之一。

ingredient.en: But there were big downsides . People no longer knew necessarily where their ingredients came from.
ingredient.zh: 但也有很大的缺点。人们不再必然知道他们的食材来自哪里。

ingredient.en: People still had vegetables, fish and bread and potatoes and other ingredients.
ingredient.zh: 人们仍然有蔬菜、鱼、面包、土豆和其他食材。

industrial.en: The Industrial Revolution changed Britain from an agricultural society into an urban, industrial society.
industrial.zh: 工业革命将英国从一个农业社会变成了一个城市化的工业社会。

industrial.en: The Industrial Revolution changed Britain from an agricultural society into an urban, industrial society.
industrial.zh: 工业革命将英国从一个农业社会变成了一个城市化的工业社会。

inside.en: If you’re in a factory, you are inside all day from 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM at night.
inside.zh: 如果你在工厂里，你一整天都待在里面，从早上7点到晚上7点。

income.en: And because working-class people had limited incomes, the quality of the food was not the priority.
income.zh: 而且由于工人阶级收入有限，食物的质量不是优先考虑的。

introduce.en: This isn’t unusual. Most countries around the world have incorporated foods introduced by immigrants.
introduce.zh: 这并不罕见。世界上大多数国家都融入了移民引入的食物。

introduce.en: During the Second World War, in January 1940, Britain introduced food rationing .
introduce.zh: 第二次世界大战期间，即1940年1月，英国实行了食物配给。

instant.en: The post-war decades saw the growth of processed food and convenience food: frozen vegetables, canned food, instant meals, microwave meals.
instant.zh: 战后几十年见证了加工食品和便利食品的增长：冷冻蔬菜、罐头食品、即食餐、微波炉食品。

intense.en: Food culture there relies on using lots of intense flavors and spices.
intense.zh: 那里的饮食文化依赖于使用大量浓郁的风味和香料。

intense.en: British cuisine didn’t develop around the idea of intense spicing.
intense.zh: 英国菜并没有围绕着浓烈香料的概念发展。

invent.en: And chicken tikka masala isn’t alone. The chicken balti, for example, was invented in Birmingham in the 1970s by Pakistani immigrants and is now a major part of Birmingham’s food culture.
invent.zh: 而且鸡肉蒂卡玛莎拉并不孤单。例如，巴蒂鸡（chicken balti）是20世纪70年代由巴基斯坦移民在伯明翰发明的，现在是伯明翰饮食文化的重要组成部分。

inspiration.en: The foods might have South Asian roots and inspiration, but they are uniquely found in Britain.
inspiration.zh: 这些食物可能有南亚的根源和灵感，但它们是英国独有的。

incorporate.en: This isn’t unusual. Most countries around the world have incorporated foods introduced by immigrants.
incorporate.zh: 这并不罕见。世界上大多数国家都融入了移民引入的食物。

inspire.en: If you go to Singapore or Malaysia, Indonesia, Thailand, the Philippines, you will find dishes that are inspired by Chinese cuisine, but they are now considered dishes of those countries.
inspire.zh: 如果你去新加坡、马来西亚、印度尼西亚、泰国、菲律宾，你会发现一些受到中国菜启发但现在被认为是那些国家菜肴的食物。

incredible.en: I’ve had people tell me before that they’ve been to London and they’ve not found anything nice to eat in London, which is incredible ’cause London is perhaps one of the best food cities in the entire world.
incredible.zh: 以前有人对我说过，他们去过伦敦，却在伦敦找不到什么好吃的东西，这太不可思议了，因为伦敦也许是全世界最好的美食城市之一。
